integrity: The proof is mathematical and self-contained; a standard-library floating-point verifier checks all finite pair instances but is not an infinite or independent certification. Originality retains normal residual bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Only real scalar Euclidean cube vertex-to-all-edge-midpoint extensions in dimensions two and three; no higher-dimensional, Banach-valued or optimizer-uniqueness claim. The principal predecessor is a January 23, 2018 preprint; earlier supporting literature is not used as the dated lead source.
title: Sharp real-linear Lipschitz extension to all edge midpoints of the Euclidean square and cube
